content.markdown:
**V1.6.6-7** of *[Stormworks: Build and Rescue](https://stormworks.fandom.com/wiki/Stormworks:_Build_and_Rescue)* was released on November 11th, 2022.

## V1.6.6-7

v1.6.6

- Fix - Negative integer table indices are now supported when saving addon script data

v.1.6.7

- Feature - Desalinator ([#6859](https://geometa.co.uk/support/stormworks/6859) [#8557](https://geometa.co.uk/support/stormworks/8557) [#8575](https://geometa.co.uk/support/stormworks/8575))
- Feature - Addon editor creature support and localization ([#14990](https://geometa.co.uk/support/stormworks/14990))

- Fix - Repaired various train-line issues ([#14877](https://geometa.co.uk/support/stormworks/14877) [#14942](https://geometa.co.uk/support/stormworks/14942) [#14976](https://geometa.co.uk/support/stormworks/14976) [#15064](https://geometa.co.uk/support/stormworks/15064) [#15275](https://geometa.co.uk/support/stormworks/15275) [#15300](https://geometa.co.uk/support/stormworks/15300) [#15350](https://geometa.co.uk/support/stormworks/15350))
- Fix - [#15494](https://geometa.co.uk/support/stormworks/15494) Custom tanks without a fluid spawner now correctly add their contents to workbench inventory on vehicle despawn
- Fix - [#14461](https://geometa.co.uk/support/stormworks/14461) Modular starter audio sfx crash/memory leak
- Fix - [#11629](https://geometa.co.uk/support/stormworks/11629) Sonar missile output failing when sampling multiple bodies
- Fix - Tutorial DLC disabling not working as intended when hosting MP games
- Fix - Improved some thread safety to avoid lockup situations
- Fix - [#13075](https://geometa.co.uk/support/stormworks/13075) Rotor end fold/unfold raycast
- Fix - [#11572](https://geometa.co.uk/support/stormworks/11572) Scuba outfit un-paintable
- Fix - [#1335](https://geometa.co.uk/support/stormworks/1335) Incorrect ui highlight when re-entering map
- Fix - [#13462](https://geometa.co.uk/support/stormworks/13462) Updated purchase dialogs to use property instead of island
- Fix - [#13469](https://geometa.co.uk/support/stormworks/13469) Missing localization strings for bindings menu
- Fix - [#13591](https://geometa.co.uk/support/stormworks/13591) E/Q camera controls in editor are inverted
- Fix - [#13689](https://geometa.co.uk/support/stormworks/13689) Hand cranks now consider damping
- Fix - [#13731](https://geometa.co.uk/support/stormworks/13731) SGK Outpost physics mesh issues
- Fix - [#13732](https://geometa.co.uk/support/stormworks/13732) Oil refinery stairs hitbox
- Fix - [#14854](https://geometa.co.uk/support/stormworks/14854) Nuclear plant mesh issues
- Fix - Campbell lighthouse light rotation speed
- Fix - several small terrain fixes for arid island
- Fix - [#14823](https://geometa.co.uk/support/stormworks/14823) Monkey Brain typo
- Fix - [#14829](https://geometa.co.uk/support/stormworks/14829) Sharpspoonful typo
- Balance - Improved rocket fin control surfaces underwater
- Balance - [#13275](https://geometa.co.uk/support/stormworks/13275) Rebalanced leak flow rate to compensate for leak spawning bugfix (reduced 3x)

- Added a preset torpedo example
- Removed the default zombies addon

## Source

- [Steam Community News](https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/573090/view/3431207144901237423?l=english)
